prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible approach it, otherwise wander around. If object is approached, pick it up and move to destination. Finally, process object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = WanderAround    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectValid    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsObjectValid? THEN
			DO ProcessObject
	END
